cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Adds parsing and text generation for weekly recurrence rules specifying hours, such as 'Every week on Sunday at 10, 12 and 17'.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'feat(nlp): support weekly by hour texts (#590)'. Adds the corresponding weekly BYHOUR test. Checked subsequent messages for reverts and commit/feature references, both source-file histories, and -G/-S searches for AT() and _byhour through origin/HEAD 9f2061febeeb363d03352efe33d30c33073a0242; no revert or correction to the added behavior was found.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Adds simplifyRange, which produces a shorter range matching the same versions within a supplied version list when possible.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'Add method for simplifying ranges'. Adds tests covering unchanged, contiguous, disjoint, and universal ranges. Checked subsequent messages for references and reverts, the complete later ranges/simplify.js diffs, and -S searches for simplifyRange through origin/HEAD 6e05b7637396ac66522cff8731f07cfe0ef49a29. Later changes add strict mode, formatting, and ESM export wiring; none corrects or reverts the introduced range algorithm.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Adds parse-positional-numbers configuration so callers can preserve numeric-looking positional arguments as strings.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'feat: adds parse-positional-numbers configuration (#321)'. Tests demonstrate both disabled coercion and the unchanged default. Checked later source histories, revert/reference messages, and -S/-G searches for parse-positional-numbers through origin/HEAD aa386be666df974a127904020c61b9febc10301f; no correction or revert of the option was found. Inspected f85ebb4: it fixes a pre-existing unknown-options positional-coercion path, rather than the guard introduced here.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Changes diff results to consistently include boolean added and removed fields, using false instead of omitted or undefined values.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'Always set `added` and `removed` to `true` or `false`, rather than leaving them unset or explicitly using `undefined` (#455)'. Updates expected objects across four test files. Checked later messages, reverts, base.js/base.ts histories, and -S/-G searches for the boolean fields through origin/HEAD 4ee9d163506fb6184625e0663a1d313b94650aad. Later token-granularity and TypeScript refactors preserve the explicit booleans; no fix or revert of this contract was found.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Adds conversions between ordinary RGB channels and Apple's 16-bit RGB channels.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'add apple RGB conversion'. Adds an RGB-to-Apple conversion assertion. Checked all subsequent conversions.js subjects, relevant apple hunks, -S searches for convert.apple.rgb, and revert/reference messages through origin/HEAD 5c106a633b5cd2de554d9c287ad31f9eeca7a271. Later changes add channel labels and modernize syntax while preserving the scaling formulas; the lookup-table revert concerns keyword conversion, not Apple RGB.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Adds single-digit boolean aliases such as -0 while retaining numeric positional parsing when no corresponding boolean flag is configured.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'feat: introduce single-digit boolean aliases (#255)'. Adds tests for enabled aliases, unconfigured digits, and negation. Checked subsequent messages for reverts/references, source history, and -S/-G searches for the single-digit branch through TypeScript and ESM migrations to origin/HEAD aa386be666df974a127904020c61b9febc10301f; the branch is retained without a later corrective change.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Adds an optional time-zone-name format argument supporting short, long, shortGeneric, and longGeneric output.
cases.evidence: Subject: '(tz): Add format option to tzName function'. Adds assertions for all four formats. Verified default-branch ancestry, checked subsequent revert/reference messages, followed tzName through the pkgs/tz subtree import, and searched with -S/-G for TZNameFormat through origin/HEAD 717ce0a807ea4c6b540d015b5c408723175b2838. Only formatting changes affect the added option; no correcting fix or revert was found.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Refactors block-mapping parsing to insert the mapping event before the already parsed first key instead of rolling back and parsing that key again.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'Parse the first block mapping key once (#800)'. Inspected the parent and changed control flow: the previously validated key and separator are reused. Checked subsequent parser history, revert/reference messages, and -S/-G searches for beforeKey.eventsLength and mappingOpened through origin/HEAD cb62b2dbbaa0b3e7379d83a5d69d8d52d21b6efb. Subsequent parser fixes concern other branches; none changes or reverts the inserted-event implementation.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Refactors internal utility and helper modules to use named exports and namespace imports instead of default-exported objects.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'Cleanup internal exports'. Updates the utility test import accordingly. Checked subsequent messages for reverts and export-related references, affected-file histories, and -S/-G searches for the namespace imports across lib-to-src and TypeScript migrations through origin/HEAD a8c00d474ec9b304fad9b71c16d6fa8b4909279e. No subsequent fix or revert attributable to this export refactor was found.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Adds a timeout option that allows diff computation to abort when its execution-time budget is exceeded.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'Add `timeout` option (#478)'. Adds a deliberately slow comparator test demonstrating timeout and successful completion with a larger budget. Checked subsequent revert/reference messages, base.js/base.ts history, and -S/-G searches for abortAfterTimestamp and maxExecutionTime through origin/HEAD 4ee9d163506fb6184625e0663a1d313b94650aad. The deadline logic survives the TypeScript and async-scheduling refactors without a correcting fix or revert.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Adds isValidCIDRFourPartDecimal to validate CIDR strings whose IPv4 address uses conventional four-part decimal notation.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'Add IPv4 CIDR four-part decimal validator'. Adds tests for valid addresses, nondecimal and abbreviated addresses, and an invalid prefix length. Checked subsequent source histories, revert/reference messages, and -S/-G searches for the new method through origin/HEAD b70b039e4085cdda7afd4163a5f526e5094046c3. Its implementation is preserved in the ESM/class migration; later CIDR-prefix validation changes concern matchCIDR, not this method.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Adds three-digit hexadecimal color input by expanding each digit before converting the color to RGB.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'add support for shorthand hex color (#39)'. Adds assertions equating ABC and AABBCC. Checked all later conversions.js subjects, the hex.rgb/colorString hunks, -S searches, and revert/reference messages through origin/HEAD 5c106a633b5cd2de554d9c287ad31f9eeca7a271. Later syntax modernization preserves the expansion algorithm; no correcting fix or revert was found.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Removes a redundant empty-array special case because Array.every already returns true for an empty array.

Checked subsequent cache.ts history, revert/reference messages, and -S/-G searches for the removed condition and argsMatch through origin/HEAD 9f2061febeeb363d03352efe33d30c33073a0242. Later changes concern formatting, imports, and a TypeScript assertion; the condition is never restored or corrected.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Refactors scalar layout calculations to express parent and content indentation explicitly while preserving the existing indentation and width calculations.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'Clarify scalar geometry vars'. Compared the old blockIndent calculation with shiftOfContent minus shiftOfParent at root and nested levels; they are equivalent. Checked subsequent presenter history, revert/reference messages, and -S/-G searches for scalarLayout, blockHeader, and the new variables through origin/HEAD cb62b2dbbaa0b3e7379d83a5d69d8d52d21b6efb. The later scalar-styler replacement retains the geometry approach; no fix or revert attributable to this refactor was found.
